# Openform

MIT-licensed conversational form builder. Independent of Typeform.

## Product
- [Website](https://arjunkshah12345-hash.github.io/openform/)
- [Source and self-hosting guide](https://github.com/arjunkshah12345-hash/openform)
- [An open-source Typeform alternative you can self-host](https://arjunkshah12345-hash.github.io/openform/guides/open-source-typeform-alternative.html)
- [How to self-host a conversational form builder](https://arjunkshah12345-hash.github.io/openform/guides/self-host-conversational-forms.html)
- [Build a conversational customer feedback form](https://arjunkshah12345-hash.github.io/openform/guides/customer-feedback-form.html)

## Important limits
GitHub Pages is a browser-local interactive demo. Self-host the Node.js/SQLite app to collect responses centrally. The app is single-owner and has no built-in login; protect administrative routes before public deployment. No conditional logic, file uploads, managed hosting, or automatic Typeform import.
